name: dev-flow
description: A repository-first Codex development flow with proportional continuity, transition-aware capability activation, repository knowledge, and final-byte evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Repository-first, proportionate development workflow for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Separates task intent, continuity, risk, and knowledge impact; defaults ordinary work to a packet-free direct path; and keeps long-running design and progress in the owning repository.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this repository and implement my request with Dev Flow.
Diagnose and fix this bug with focused native verification.
Design and implement this long-running change with repository-tracked requirements, design, and progress.
Audit this repository and propose a maintainable knowledge system for people and agents.
